scenario: Discussing a news story with a colleague
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Katika mazingira ya habari, inamaanisha ripoti au taarifa.
Hutumiwa kusema kuhusu mada au tatizo.
Kiongozi ambao huingiza ukubali.
Matokeo au athari ya kitu chochote.
Fahamu ambao inaonyesha kuongezeka.
Kundi la viongozi ambao hudhibiti nchi.
Inaendana na watu wote au serikali (si binafsi).
Kifahamu ambao kinachoonesha uwezo.
Kuchagua uamuzi.
Inaonyesha upinzani.
Kiongozi ambao huingiza ukubali.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you see the report about the new public transport plan?
dialogue.translation: Je, ulimwona ripoti kuhusu mpango mpya wa nyamamili ya umma?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I read it. Although the government says it will help, many people are against it.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, nimeosoma. Hata ingawa serikali inasema itasaidia, watu wengi wanayo dhidi yake.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the main issue is the cost. It might increase taxes, and that could have a big effect on the economy.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri tatizo kubwa ni gharama. Inaweza kuongeza magharibi, na hilo lingeweza kuwa na athari kubwa kwenye uchumi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Probably, but they say it will create more jobs. I'm not sure what they will decide.
dialogue.translation: Labda, lakini wanasemaji itazoa nafasi za kazi zaidi. Sijaiwakilisha wanachotaka kuamua.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but if they cut other services, it will be a problem. The public might be more affected than they think.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini iwapo watakata huduma nyingine, itakuwa tatizo. Umma unaweza kupatikana zaidi kuliko wanavyo fikiri.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's wait and see. Although I'm a bit worried, I hope they make a good choice.
dialogue.translation: Tufanye tuendelee na kuona. Hata ingawa nina wasiwasi kidogo, nina matumaini watafanya uchaguzi mzuri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we can only hope. I'll check the news again tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, tuweze tuwe na matumaini tu. Nitachunguza habari tena kesho.

scenario: Negotiating a minor disagreement
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuelezea ushirikiano na maoni au taklifu.
Inawekwa mwisho wa jambo kutoa maelezo ya maoni.
Kutoa camo la camo bila kutoa ahadi.
Inaonyesha badala ya kile kilichojulikana kabla.
Fikira au mikakati ya kufanya jambo fulani.
Kubadilisha kitu, kufanya tofauti.
Inatumika kuelezea mada au tatizo.
Inaelezea uhakika au ushirikiano.
Kama 'maybe', lakini kidogo cha kiasili zaidi.
Inaelezea kutokuwa na kitu au kupunguza kitu.
Inaongeza fikra inayotoa tofauti na iliyotangulia.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I don't agree with your plan to go to the beach, though.
dialogue.translation: Sijui kama nina makusanyiko na mpango wako wa kwenda kwenye kivumba, lakini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we could change the time instead of changing the place.
dialogue.translation: Labda tunaweza kubadilisha muda badala ya kubadilisha mahali.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I'm not sure it's the best matter to discuss right now.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni fikra njema, lakini sina uhakika kama ni jambo bora zaidi kuelezea sasa hivi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perhaps we should just decide together without arguing.
dialogue.translation: Labda tunapaswa tu kuchagua pamoja bila kujadiliana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree, but I still think the plan has a problem, though.
dialogue.translation: Nina makusanyiko, lakini bado ninafikiri kwamba mpango ana tatizo, ingawa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe we can try a different plan, perhaps a picnic instead?
dialogue.translation: Labda tunaweza kujaribu mpango mwingine, labda picnic badala yake?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, that could work without any problem. Let's do that, though.
dialogue.translation: Ndio, inaweza kufanya kazi bila tatizo lo lote. Tufanye hivyo, lakini.

scenario: Giving feedback on someone's work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kuelezea kwamba jambo la kufanyika bado halijatokea.
Inaelezea tofauti. Tadhira: 'though' imeingizwa katika orodha ya kutengenezwa kama ukata wa mfumo.
Inaelezea kiwango cha utendaji wa kitu chochote.
Hutumiwa kuweka nguvu au kuelezea kiwango cha kitu chochote.
Kufanya jambo la kufanyika kuwa bora zaidi.
Matokeo au athari ya kitendo chochote.
Hutumiwa kuweka mwanzo wa fikra inayotoa tofauti na ile iliyotangulia.
Kufikiri kuhusu jambo la kufanyika kabla ya kufanya uamuzi.
Inaweza kutokea au kufanyika.
Kutoa au kuweka kitu chochote kinachohitajika.
Kusaidia au kushikamana na mtu au jambo la kufanyika.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I’ve read your draft, but I haven’t finished the last section yet.
dialogue.translation: Nimeosoma waraka lako la mwanzo, lakini bado sija maliza sehemu ya mwisho.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That’s okay. The quality of the beginning is quite good, I think.
dialogue.translation: Ni sawa. Ubora wa mwanzo ni wa kina, nayo ni maana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I agree with that, though we need to improve the ending a lot.
dialogue.translation: Nina uafaka na hiyo, lakini tunahitaji kuboresha mwisho mwingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, the result is not strong enough. However, your ideas are clear.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, matokeo hayana nguvu kutosha. Lakini, mawazo yako ni wazi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks. What else should I consider for the final version?
dialogue.translation: Asante. Ni nini nyingine ninachohitaji kufikiri kuhusu toleo la mwisho?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It’s possible to add more examples, and provide more evidence for your claims.
dialogue.translation: Inaweza kuwepo zaidi ya mifano, na kutoa ushahidi zaidi kwa matumaini yako.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I’ll work on that. Can you support me with the data?
dialogue.translation: Nzuri, nitafanya kazi kuhusu hiyo. Unaweza kusaidia na data?

key_phrases.translation: Ni nini nyingine ninachohitaji kufikiri kuhusu?

scenario: Explaining a problem to customer service
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I received my order yesterday, but the color is wrong.
dialogue.translation: Habari, nimepokea agizo langu jana, lakini rangi ni hali isiyotokana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Could you send me a photo of the item you received?
dialogue.translation: Samahani kusikia hayo. Je, unaweza kunituma picha ya kipengele ulichopokea?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll send it right away. Also, I need to return the item and get a refund.
dialogue.translation: Ndio, nitatumia mara moja. Pia, ninahitaji kurudisha kipengele na kupata ufunguzi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. We will not charge you for the return. Please check your email for instructions.
dialogue.translation: Bilazima. Hatutakukutoa kwa kurudisha. Tafadhali angalia barua pepe yako kwa maelezo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. How long will I have to wait for the refund?
dialogue.translation: Asante. Nitahitaji kusubiri muda gani ili kupata ufunguzi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Usually it takes 5–7 days. Please be careful with the return label we provide.
dialogue.translation: Kwa kawaida inachukua siku 5–7. Tafadhali uwe wenye wasiwasi na kipengele cha kurudisha tunachotoa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, I'll be careful. Thank you for solving my problem.
dialogue.translation: Nzuri, nitakuwa wenye wasiwasi. Asante kwa kutatua tatizo langu.

scenario: Talking about ambitions and career goals
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kwa malengo au lengo, zaidi ya rasmi kuliko 'get'.
Ina maana ya historia ya kazi, si 'kazi ya chuo kikuu'.
Tayari imeingizwa, lakini inaongezwa katika orodha ili kufikia idadi.
Pia inaweza kuwa 'kuleta kwenye'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to achieve a high position in my career, but I know it will require a lot of effort.
dialogue.translation: Nataka kufikia nafa juu katika kazi yangu, lakini najua itahitaji juhudi nyingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a great goal. What kind of role would you like to reach in the future?
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni lengo njema. Aina gani ya jukumu unataka kufikia siku za usoni?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd love to lead a team someday, but I think I need more experience first.
dialogue.translation: Ningependa kuwashughulisha kikundi siku moja, lakini nadhani ninahitaji uzoefu zaidi kwanza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you can find an opportunity to manage a small project at work.
dialogue.translation: Labda unaweza kupata fursa ya kushughulisha mradi mdogo kazini.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope so. Success doesn't come overnight, so I'll continue studying and improving my skills.
dialogue.translation: Naitazama hivyo. Mafanikio hayaja kwa usiku, kwa hiyo nitaweka kuendelea kujifunza na kuimarisha ujuzi wangu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's the right attitude. I'm sure you'll achieve everything you set your mind to.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni mwendo wa kweli. Ninaweka itakufikia kila kitu unachokiweka akili yako.

scenario: Discussing health habits and lifestyle
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inaonyesha umbali wa kutendeka kwa tabia.
Inamaanisha mwili wa kina.
Pia inaweza kuwa jina, lakini hapa imechukuliwa kama kibali.
Hali ya kawaida ya afya ya kimwili na kiroho.
Uwezo wa kufanya kazi.
Hali ya usingizi.
Tabia au utaratibu.
Kinafaida afya.
Matatizo ya kimwili au kiroho.
Kiongozi cha sababu.
Kilinganifu cha 'good' (mzuri).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to exercise in the morning, but I don't do it often.
dialogue.translation: Ninajaribu kufanya mazoezi asubuhi, lakini sinafutia kufanya hivyo mara nyingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's okay. The important thing is to listen to your body and find a routine that works for you.
dialogue.translation: Ni sawa. Jambo la maana ni kuisikiliza mwili wako na kupata utaratibu unayoweza kufanya.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know. I feel much better when I have more energy during the day.
dialogue.translation: Najua. Ninahisi vizuri zaidi wakati ninapo uwezo mkubwa zaidi wakati wa mchana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and sleep is a key part of that. Do you sleep at least seven hours?
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, na usingizi ni sehemu ya maana ya hayo. Unapata usingizi wa saa saba?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Usually, yes. But my main problem is stress, not sleep.
dialogue.translation: Kwa kawaida, ndiyo. Lakini tatizo langu kubwa ni matatizo, si usingizi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Stress can affect your health a lot. Maybe you need a new habit to relax, like reading or walking.
dialogue.translation: Matatizo inaweza kukusanya afya yako sana. Labda unahitaji tabia mpya ya kupumzika, kama kusoma au kutembea.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, because I want to feel healthier overall.
dialogue.translation: Ni fikra njema, kwa sababu nina takwa kuhisi afya njema zaidi kwa ujumla.

key_phrases.translation: kuhisi afya njema zaidi kwa ujumla

scenario: Describing a recent trip in detail
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuhusu safari nzima, hasa ya furaha au biashara.
Fili regular; katika zamani hutumika 'arrived'.
Pia ni jina: 'a stay' = kuhifadhi.
Kiongozi cha kuweka mawazo tofauti.
Inaongeza ujumbe wa kubali.
Ina maana kuhusu kile kinachopatikana kutoka kwenye sehemu fulani.
Sifa isiyo na mfano 'great' lakini ina maana zaidi.
Hutumiwa kuweka nguvu, lakini si kama 'very'.
Katika zamani 'decided'.
Inaweza kuwa kama jina au si kama jina; hapa ina maana kuhusu uzoefu.
Pia ni jina: 'travel' = kusafiri kwa ujumla.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How was your trip to the mountains last weekend?
dialogue.translation: Safari yako ya mwisho wa wiki ilikuwa vipi kwenye milima?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It was quite wonderful, but we arrived later than we expected because of the traffic.
dialogue.translation: Ilikuwa nzuri sana, lakini tulifika baada ya muda tuliofikiri kwa sababu ya trafik.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you stay in a hotel or in a cabin?
dialogue.translation: Mlikaa katika hoteli au nyumba ya kawaida?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We stayed in a small cabin with an amazing view of the lake.
dialogue.translation: Tulikaa katika nyumba ya kawaida ndogo yenye mwangaza mzuri wa ziwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the weather was cloudy, did you still enjoy the experience?
dialogue.translation: Ingawa hali ya hewa ilikuwa na mawingu, bado mlikijioni uzoefu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we decided to go hiking, and we had a wonderful time, however, the trail was quite steep.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, tulichagua kwenda kwenye safari ya kushuka, na tulikuwa na muda mzuri, lakini njia ilikuwa na kivunjao kikali.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm glad you had such a good time. I love to travel to new places too.
dialogue.translation: Nina furaha kwa sababu mlikuwa na muda mzuri. Pia ninapenda kusafiri kwenye sehemu mpya.

scenario: Talking about environmental issues
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kushirikisha jambo fulani linaloleta madhara, mara nyingi yenye madhara.
Neno muhimu kunena kuhusu kupunguza athari za mazingira.
Inamaanisha hatua au lengo ambalo linachukuliwa.
Jina la kwanza la mada huu. Hutumika na 'the'.
Inaelezea jambo ambalo ni wa kawaida au linashirikiwa.
Hutumiwa kuweka uzuri kwamba kitu ni moja tu, kama katika 'single-use' (kutumiwa mara moja tu).
Inaelezea uwezo mkubwa wa kutokea. Hutumika kama kibali cha jumla.
Hutumiwa kuelezea matatizo makubwa au ya maana.
Inaelezea kwamba hali inaendelea. Pia inaweza maana 'hata hivyo'.
Mwishowe ya jumla ina maana 'hata hivyo'. Mwanzoni, ina maana 'ingawa'.
Hutumiwa kuelezea kuwa dhidi ya jambo fulani au kupambana na jambo fulani.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think plastic waste is a serious problem, but people still use too much of it.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri kwamba takataka za plastiki ni tatizo kubwa, lakini watu bado wanatumia mengi sana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Najua. Hitilafu wa kawaida ni kutumia mafuta ya plastiki ya kutumiwa mara moja tu kwa kila kitu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Ndio hivyo. Tabia hiyo inaweza kuleta madhara mengi kwa mazingira baada ya muda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: Hivyo, ni hatua gani bora tunaweza kuchukua ili kupunguza athari zetu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.
dialogue.translation: Vyema, kutumia chombo cha kutumiwa tena ni hatua rastari. Na inawakilisha uwezo mkubwa wa kutokea kuwa tabia haraka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.
dialogue.translation: Hilo ina maana. Sizimi dhidi ya mabadiliko madogo, hata ingawa. Kila kitu kidogo kinasaidia.

key_phrases.translation: mafuta ya plastiki ya kutumiwa mara moja tu

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Fiili isiyostahili msingi: choose, chose, chosen.
Jina la kihisi.
Neno lisilo na maana 'choice'.
Katika mazingira ya uamuzi, maana yake ni kuweka vipengele vya kufaa na visivyo kufaa.
Ina maana ya matokeo ya mwisho ya uamuzi.
Inaweza kuwa jina la kihisi au fiili.
Inaelezea uhakika au jambo la kina ambalo halijatoa maelezo.
Hutumiwa kuelezea hatua au uamuzi wa mwisho.
Hutumiwa kuelezea upendeleo.
Huanzisha uamuzi.
Huelezea sababu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Nilipasa kuchagua kati ya fursa mbili za kazi wiki iliyopita.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni uamuzi wa nguvu. Ulipima chikamu gani?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Nilifikiria mishahara na usafiri, lakini hatari ya kwenda mjini mpya ilikuwa jambo kubwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: Ulihakika kuhusu matokeo ya kila chikamu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Si kabisa, ingawa nilijua kwamba mishahara ilikuwa kubwa zaidi kazini ya pili.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Basi, ulichagua nini mwishowe?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Nilichagua kazi ya kwanza, kwa kufanya ya pili, kwa sababu ya usafiri mfupi zaidi na usawa bora zaidi wa maisha na kazi.

scenario: Explaining why you changed your mind
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa na 'mind' kuelezea mabadiliko ya maoni.
Katika 'change your mind' maana yake ni kubadilisha maoni.
Hutumiwa kuelezea kipindi ambacho unabadilisha fikra yako.
Hutumiwa kuweka taarifa za kweli.
Inaweza kutumiwa kwa kina au kielelezo.
Inamaanisha nia au mradi.
Huelezea uwezo.
Hutumiwa kutoa tofauti na lililokuwa likitafakariwa kabla.
Kama kushiriki maana yake ni 'kwa sababu'.
Huelezea badiliko.
Mwishowe wa jina limeaanisha 'hata ingawa'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Nimebadilisha maoni yangu kuhusu safari kwenda kwenye basheni wiki hii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Kweli? Kwa nini? Ulionekana unakifurahi sana kuhusu hilo kabla.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Vyema, nimegundua kwamba taarifa za hali ya hewa si nzuri, na kweli, nina kazi nyingi ya kufanya.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Lakini ulikuwa na mpango wa kupumzika na kufurahia jua!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini nimegundua kwamba si imkanu kumaliza mradi wangu nikigeuka. Kwa sababu muda mwishowe ni Jumatatu, lazima nikae nyumbani.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni kweli. Lakini unaweza kufanya kazi asubuhi na kwenda baadaye, badala ya kuondoa kila kitu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni fikra njema, hata ingawa lazima nione kama rafiki yangu anaweza kusaidia kwenye safari. Asante kwa ushauri!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ina maana mila, mawazo na desturi za kikundi.
Tabia au desturi ya kawaida katika eneo fulani.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Ninaona kama jambo la kufurahisha jinsi tofauti nyingi za utamaduni zilizopo kati ya nchi mbalimbali.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, hata jambo kama salamu inaweza kuwa mila inayobadilisha tabia za watu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Kwa mfano, katika utamaduni wangu ni mkubwa roho kula kwa mikono, lakini katika baadhi ya sehemu ni waadabu kabisa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Kwa kawaida nataraji watu kufuata mila za kimataifa, lakini ninajikinga kuwaheshimu mila tofauti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni jambo la kufurahisha. Naona mila mwingi ni sawa katika asili, tu zimeelezewa kwa njia tofauti.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Hivyo, ufunguo ni kuwa mwanzo na kujifunza kuhusu tofauti kati yetu.

scenario: Discussing technology in daily life
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Tumia kuweka pamoja vifaa au watu.
Kifaa cha kielektroniki kama simu au taabli.
Sehemu ambayo inaonyesha picha.
Programu inayosetiwa kwenye simu.
Kuhamisha au kuwapa wengine ufikiaji.
Inayotumika kwenye intaneti.
Chanzo cha nishati kwa vifaa.
Ujumbe fupi au maelezo.
Kuletea data kutoka kwenye intaneti hadi kifaa chako.
Mtu anayotumia kitu, hasa teknolojia.
Rahisi kufanya au kuelewa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to connect my new phone to the Wi-Fi, but I can't find the settings.
dialogue.translation: Ninahitaji kuweka simu yangu mpya kwenye Wi-Fi, lakini siwezi kupata mipangilio.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Ni jambo lisilo na taabu. Nenda tu kwenye programu ya mipangilio na tafuta chaguo cha Wi-Fi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.
dialogue.translation: Oh, nimeelewa. Lakini pia ninataka kupakua programu jipya ya ujumbe ili niwasiliane na marafiki wangu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Ni jambo muhimu, lakini angalia betri kwanza. Kupakua kinatumia nishati nyingi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.
dialogue.translation: Unasema kweli. Na skrini? Mara nyingi inaendelea kuwa kwenye hali ya kuwa kwa muda mrefu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Pia unaweza kubadilisha hiyo katika mipangilio. Pia, kama mtumiaji, unapaswa kushiriki mahali yako na marafiki tu wakati wa kusadiki.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Asante! Sasa ninapata furaha zaidi kutumia kifaa changu kwenye mtandao.

scenario: At a formal meeting giving your opinion
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa katika mazingira rasmi kuelezea maoni.
Katika mikusanyiko rasmi, inamaanisha jambo au tatizo linayotakiwa kuchunguzwa.
Hutumiwa kuweka mbele hujja au fikra.
Feli inayotumiwa kuelezea ubunifu.
Hutumiwa kutoa taka au hatua kwa njia ya rasmi.
Hutumiwa kuelezea kwamba unaweka jambo katika fikra kabla ya kufanya uamuzi.
Kiongozi unachokiongoza tofauti katika hotuba ya rasmi.
Kiongozi unachokiongoza matokeo ya mantiki.
Inayotumiwa katika njia ya kiingereza na kiingereza kuelezea uwezo.
Hutumiwa kutoa chanzo au data.
Kiongozi wa kuweka taarifa zaidi katika hotuba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: In my view, the main issue is the budget for the project.
dialogue.translation: Kwa mwangaza wangu, tatizo kubwa ni bajeti ya mradi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see your point, however, I think we should consider the timeline first.
dialogue.translation: Nimeelewa pointi yako, lakini, nadhani tunapaswa kufikiri mwanzo wa muda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is a valid point. Therefore, perhaps we can discuss both together.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni pointi ya kweli. Kwa hiyo, labda tunaweza kuchunguza pamoja.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree with that. In addition, we could ask for more data from the team.
dialogue.translation: Ninabali na hiyo. Pia, tunaweza omba taarifa zaidi kutoka kwenye kundi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. According to the latest report, we have some flexibility.
dialogue.translation: Fikra njema. Kulingana na ripoti ya mwisho, tuna uwezo wowote.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I suggest we prepare a proposal with both options.
dialogue.translation: Hivyo ninaadhimisha tuandike taka lenye bei mbili.

scenario: Describing a person's character in depth
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuwasilisha mtu anayesema kweli.
Inaelezea mtu anayekabili hatari bila hofu.
Mtu anayeopa bila kutaraji kitu chochote badala yake.
Wenye uwezo wa kusubiri bila kujitahidi.
Anavyoona wasiwasi au kushindwa na watu wasiojulikana.
Anayewatendea wengine vizuri.
Rahisi kumpata na anayefurahisha.
Inatumika katika 'sense of humor' (hisia ya kucheka).
Halia ya hisia inayobadilika kwa muda mfupi.
Mara nyingi.
Inaongozwa sababu au sababu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I really admire my sister because she is always honest, even when it's difficult.
dialogue.translation: Ninampenda sana dada yangu kwa sababu yoyote ni wa kweli, hata wakati ni ngumu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's great. My best friend is very brave – he once stood up to a bully at school.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni jambo la kufurahia. Rafiki yangu mzuri ni wa kushinda - mara moja alisimama mbele ya mtu mwenye nguvu katika shule.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Wow, that takes courage. My sister is also generous and often helps our neighbors with their groceries.
dialogue.translation: Wow, hiyo inahitaji ujasiri. Dada yangu pia ni mwenye kutoa na mara nyingi anawasaidia jirani wetu kwa vyakula vyao.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She sounds kind. My friend is usually patient, but he can get into a bad mood if he's tired.
dialogue.translation: Inaonekana kuwa mwenye kuwatendea wengine vizuri. Rafiki yangu mara nyingi ni mwenye kusubiri, lakini anaweza kupata halia mbaya ya hisia ikiwa amechoka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My sister is a bit shy at first, but once you know her, she's very friendly.
dialogue.translation: Ninaelewa. Dada yangu ni kidogo wa kushindwa na watu wasiojulikana kwa mwanzo, lakini baada ya kumjua, ni mwenye kuwatendea wengine vizuri.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's nice. My friend has a great sense of humor – he always makes me laugh.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni jambo la kufurahia. Rafiki yangu ana hisia njema ya kucheka - mara nyingi hanyesha furaha.

scenario: Talking about education and learning
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kujifunza ujuzi au uwezo.
Kufanya kazi ya kujifunza kitu chochote.
Mtu anayefundisha.
Mtu anayesoma.
Kumbukumbu cha masomo kuhusu jambo fulani.
Kwa mfano kuhusu kanuni au mawazo.
Jambo la kuweka swali kuhusu taarifa.
Kutoa jibu kwa swali.
Kuelewa maana ya kitu chochote.
Kumbuka kitu katika akili yako.
Kufanya kazi mara nyingi ili kuwa bora zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need to study more for my English course, but I don't have much time.
dialogue.translation: Ninahitaji kusoma zaidi kwa ajili ya kurse yangu ya Kiingereza, lakini sina muda mkubwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Why don't you practice with me every evening? We can learn together.
dialogue.translation: Mbona usijaribu nami kila jioni? Tunaweza kujifunza pamoja.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, but I have a question: do you think our teacher will help us if we don't understand something?
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni fikra njema, lakini nina swali: Je, unadhani mwalimu wetu atasaididia kama hatutafutahi kitu chochote?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course, our teacher always answers every question with a clear example.
dialogue.translation: Bilazima, mwalimu wetu husuja kila swali kwa mfano wenye ufunuo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I hope I can remember all the new words we learn.
dialogue.translation: Natumaini nitakumbuka maneno yote mapya tunayojifunza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: If you practice daily, you will see that you remember more easily.
dialogue.translation: Kama unajaribu kila siku, utaona kwamba unakumbuka zaidi kwa urahisi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's start today, and I'll be a better student!
dialogue.translation: Wewe ni sahihi. Tuanze leo, nami nitakuwa mwanafunzi mzuri zaidi!

key_phrases.phrase: Why don't you practice with me?

scenario: Discussing a problem and offering solutions
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa na 'problem'.
Mara nyingi hutumiwa na 'find' au 'offer'.
Ijapokuwa imetokea katika orodha ya kutokana, imeongezwa hapa na ubunifu tofauti: 'kubali kwenye' (kubali kwenye).
Katika mazingira haya maana yake ni 'ngumu', si 'kali'.
Hutumiwa kutoa maoni kwa kiwango cha heshima.
Inaonyesha matokeo au utaratibu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have a big problem with the schedule for next week.
dialogue.translation: Tuna tatizo kubwa na programu ya wiki ijayo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I know it's hard, but maybe we can find a solution together.
dialogue.translation: Najua ni ngumu, lakini labda tunaweza kupata suluhisho pamoja.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd like to offer my idea: we could move the meeting to Friday.
dialogue.translation: Ningetaka kutoa maoni yangu: tunaweza kubadilisha mikusanyiko hadi Ijumaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds easy to do, but will everyone agree on the new time?
dialogue.translation: Inaonekana kama jambo rahisi, lakini watu wote watabali kwenye muda mpya?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Let's ask them first, and then we can decide what to do.
dialogue.translation: Tuwaulize wao kwanza, na halafu tutaweza kuamua tutafanya nini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good plan. Let's do that and solve this problem today.
dialogue.translation: Mpango wa kutosha. Tufanye hivyo na tuhalue tatizo hili leo.

scenario: Comparing two options for a trip
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kufanya uamuzi kati ya mawazo.
Verb isiyostahili: ghalio, ghalio, ghalio.
Ina maana muda, si kasi ya kimwili.
Hutumiwa kuweka kitu kwenye.
Kilingana cha kidogo.
Hutumiwa katika kilingana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I can't decide which option to choose for our trip: the bus or the train.
dialogue.translation: Siwezi kuchagua kipindi chochote kwa safari yetu: basi au treni.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, the bus is cheaper than the train, but it's slower.
dialogue.translation: Vyema, basi ni rkhis kuliko treni, lakini ni poteza zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the train costs more, and we need to arrive quickly.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini treni ina ghalio zaidi, na tunahitaji kufika haraka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Also, the train is safer, especially at night.
dialogue.translation: Pia, treni ni salama zaidi, hasa usiku.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But the train is more expensive, and we can bring more luggage on the bus.
dialogue.translation: Lakini treni ni ghali zaidi, na tunaweza kuweka mambo zaidi kwenye basi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true. So maybe we should take the bus and spend less money.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni kweli. Kwa hiyo labda tunapaswa kufanya basi na kutumia fedha chache.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's go with the bus. We can save money and still have fun.
dialogue.translation: Sawa, tuende na basi. Tunaweza kuhifadhi fedha na bado kuwa na furaha.

scenario: Talking about social media habits
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kama vitendo (kupost) na kama jina (post).
Inawezekana katika mitandao ya kijamii: kushiriki maudhui.
Kufuatia mtu katika mitandao ya kijamii.
Feed ni orodha ya maposti unayoyona.
Kama jina: 'a like' = 'penda'.
Pia inatumika kama vitendo: kutoa maoni.
Inaelezea kuwa mwenye usambazaji wa intaneti.
Inatumika kwa ajili ya mipangilio ya faragha.
Kinyume na 'binadamu'.
Wasifu wako kwenye mtandao wa kijamii.
Inaelezea tabia za kawaida.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How often do you usually post on social media?
dialogue.translation: Mara ngapi unapopost kwenye mitandao ya kijamii kwa kawaida?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to share something every day, but sometimes I just scroll through my feed without posting.
dialogue.translation: Ninaongea kushiriki kitu chochote kila siku, lakini mara nyingi ninapita tu kwenye feed yangu bila kupost.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow many people?
dialogue.translation: Unawafuata watu wengi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I mostly follow friends and family. I don't like getting too many likes or comments, so I keep my profile private.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini kwa kawaida ninafuata marafiki na familia. Sizipendi kupata penda au maoni mengi, kwa hiyo ninaweka wasifu wangu binadamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's smart. I have a public profile because I want more people to see my posts.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni hekima. Nina wasifu wa umma kwa sababu nataka watu wengi kuona maposti yangu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. But being online all the time can be exhausting, so I limit my time.
dialogue.translation: Ninaelewa. Lakini kuwa kwenye mtandao kwa muda mrefu inaweza kuwa kitu cha kushangaza, kwa hiyo ninachukua muda wangu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. Maybe I should do that too.
dialogue.translation: Una haki. Labda ni lazima nipate kufanya hivyo pia.

key_phrases.translation: kuwa kwenye mtandao kwa muda mrefu

scenario: Giving a short presentation at work
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kuweka sehemu za kitu chochote.
Hutakasa kitu cha maana zaidi.
Katika utangulizi, 'pointi mkuu' ni fikra ya msingi.
Hutumiwa kupita sehemu ijayo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start. My presentation will include three main parts.
dialogue.translation: Sawa, tuanzene. Utangulizi wangu utajumuisha sehemu tatu za msingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds good. What is your first point?
dialogue.translation: Inaonekana vizuri. Ni nini pointi yako ya kwanza?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The first part is about our sales results from last month.
dialogue.translation: Sehemu ya kwanza inahusu matokeo ya uzalishaji wetu mwezi uliopita.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And what will you cover next?
dialogue.translation: Na utagambia nini baada ya hiyo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Next, I'll talk about our main challenges during that period.
dialogue.translation: Baada ya hiyo, nitazungumza kuhusu changamoto zetu kubwa wakati huo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Will you also mention the new marketing strategy?
dialogue.translation: Je, utaziongezea pia mikakati ya biashara mpya?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's an important point, and I'll end with our goals for this month.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, ni pointi ya maana, na nitakomalika na malengo yetu ya mwezi huu.

scenario: Discussing a sport or hobby you follow
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Katika mlingoting'i huu maana yake ni kufuatia mchezo au timu, si katika mitandao ya kijamii.
Hutumiwa kwa matukio ya michezo.
Zamani: won.
Zamani: lost.
Pia inaweza kuwa jina: gol.
Hutumiwa kuweka tofauti kati ya mawazo.
Hutumiwa katika michezo: kucheza dhidi ya timu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you follow any sport? I'm really into football.
dialogue.translation: Unafuata mchezo wowote? Mimi ni mshauku wa mpira wa miguu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I watch basketball. My favorite team is the Lakers, although they don't win every match.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, ninatazama mchezo wa kipande. Timu yangu ya kipekee ni Lakers, ingawa hushindi kila mchezo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: They played against the Celtics last night, right? Who scored the most points?
dialogue.translation: Waliucheza dhidi ya Celtics usiku wa jana, je? Nani alifanya gol zaidi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, but we lost. Their best player had an amazing game.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini tulipoteza. Mcheza wa bora zaidi wao alifanya mchezo wa kushangaza.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a shame. Do you think they have a chance in the playoffs this season?
dialogue.translation: Hii ni aibu. Unadhani wana fursa katika michezo ya kufikia kiwango cha juu kiasi hiki mwaka?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Labda, lakini ni ngumu. Ingawa wana wachezaji wazuri, wanahitaji kuboresha uindaji wao.
